image_description: The image displays two adult common iguanas (Iguana iguana) resting on a paved surface interspersed with grass. The iguana on the left is positioned in profile, facing right, showcasing its full body length, prominent dorsal crest, and long tail extending towards the bottom left. The iguana on the right faces forward-left, displaying its head, dewlap, and front limbs. Both exhibit characteristic greenish-grey coloration with some orange/yellow hues on the lower bodies, typical of mature males.
